test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: L is the husband of O. Q is the mother-in-law of O. P is the sister of L. P is married to R. R has one son T. How is Q related to T?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2061f1a3801affb74a2e3ac9aac9924111b2d1e40b6143f2bd53ee102bb16535.png] 

Clearly, Q is grandmother (mother's mother) of T.

Hence, ‘**Mother’s mother**’ is the correct answer.
